runs.scratchReason:
The verdict claims the tests require fixing "unrelated pre-existing GopherJS compiler bugs (& operator for promoted fields and closures, and reflect.Swapper)" that "were not specified". This is wrong on two points.

reflect.Swapper is not pre-existing. Swapping through (*[2]In2)(unsafe.Pointer(&in)) gives [{2} {1}] on unpatched GopherJS, native Go and the reference, but [{2} {2}] on this run. The bug comes from this run's own view proxies.

The closure and promoted-field failures are specified. The failing assertions compare converted pointers to one variable: "ptcIntPtr(&n) inside a function literal != ptcIntPtr(&n) outside of it", "conversions of &o.x and &o.ptcEmbedded.x are not equal", "unsafe.Pointer(&o.x) != unsafe.Pointer(&o.ptcEmbedded.x)". The description states: "pointers to the same variable must be equal after being converted to the same type, including unsafe.Pointer". These are stated requirements, not unrelated `&` behavior.

criteria.label: Solvable

criteria.description: At least 4 runs must complete on each of Nova, Orion and Vega
criteria.label: Rollouts on every model

criteria.description: Exactly one of Nova, Orion or Vega solves it, more than 0% and at most 25% of the time; the other two stay at 0%
criteria.detail: Nova 1/12 solved · Orion 0/4 solved · Vega 0/4 solved
criteria.label: Solved by one model only

criteria.description: Nova runs must average more than 400K tokens of sequence length
criteria.label: Long horizon

criteria.description: Cheat rate must be below 20% (across all agents)
criteria.label: No cheating

criteria.description: No run should be blocked by environment or verifier issues
criteria.guidance: Some agent runs were blocked by environment or verifier issues rather than the agent's own mistakes. Check your test setup, dependencies, and verifier for problems before re-running.
criteria.label: No environment blockers

criteria.description: Passing runs must hold up under the false-positive review panel
criteria.detail: Stale — the task or its passing runs changed since the last check
criteria.guidance: The task or its rollout passes changed since the last FP check, so its result no longer covers the current evidence. Re-run the check before submitting.
criteria.label: No false positives
